rationale: All 6 devices showed offline simultaneously in the app while the base station reported online=false, uplink_status=no_internet, and E-503, pointing to a base-station-level network fault rather than individual device problems. results.text: The base station could not deliver events to the cloud. Frontline action: verify internet access, restart router and base station, set router DNS to automatic. If E-503 persists after these steps while the base station is online, escalate to FAE (cloud channel or certificate issue).

Base station online, live view works on local network, but no event notifications; E-503 every few minutes. Router restart and DNS reset did not help. Escalated; expired device certificate on backend. Escalated correctly.

The base station connects to the home router by Ethernet (recommended) or 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. If all cameras and sensors show offline in the app at the same time, first check whether the base station itself is online. Power-cycle the router, wait 2 minutes, then power-cycle the base station. The base station requires outbound TCP 443 and 8883 to the cloud.

complaint: Hi, everything in my security app went grey around 7 this morning: all my cameras and sensors show offline and I get no notifications at all. Yesterday afternoon our internet provider's technician replaced the router, and since then the Wi-Fi on my laptop works fine. I tried opening the app on mobile data and it says the base station is unreachable. I'm travelling next week, so I need this working. I think the base station has died.
